python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

# In obs_0060:
# Pose 60: pos = (0.086, 3.80), heading = 135 deg
# Floor lamp base: col ~ 230..280, y ~ 350..380
# Plant 2 pot: bottom left
# Sofa: left
img60 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0060.png')

# Floor lamp base:
lamp_mask = (img60[:,:,0] > 70) & (img60[:,:,0] < 100) & (img60[:,:,1] > 70) & (img60[:,:,1] < 95) & (img60[:,:,2] > 70) & (img60[:,:,2] < 95)
ys, xs = np.where(lamp_mask & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 200) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 300))
print('Lamp in obs 60 xs:', xs.min(), xs.max(), 'ys:', ys.min(), ys.max())
contact_y = ys.max()
center_x = (xs.min() + xs.max()) / 2.0
f, h, cy, cx = 256.0, 1.55, 255.5, 255.5
d = f * h / (contact_y - cy)
dx = (center_x - cx) * d / f
# heading 135 deg:
# dir_forward = [sin(135), cos(135)] = [sqrt(2)/2, -sqrt(2)/2]
# dir_right = [cos(135), -sin(135)] = [-sqrt(2)/2, -sqrt(2)/2]
rad = np.deg2rad(135)
lamp_x = 0.086 + d * np.sin(rad) + dx * np.cos(rad)
lamp_y = 3.80 + d * np.cos(rad) - dx * np.sin(rad)
print(f'Lamp from obs 60: d={d:.3f}, dx={dx:.3f} -> x={lamp_x:.3f}, y={lamp_y:.3f}')
"
